_meta.purpose: 5 ja-flavored scenarios that surface Japanese-specific failure modes (敬語 register, indirect 不満 framing, 飲み会/既読 group dynamics, 家族 obligation, short ambiguous trigger as ja counterpart to en_ambiguous_short for cross-locale parity).
_meta.translation_notes: Primary authorship in ja; en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant adapt cultural referents (e.g. 飲み会 -> office happy hour / 团建 / 應酬). The ja column is the source of truth when scoring nuance, particularly for register/敬語.

scenarios._failure_mode: keigo register on workplace topic — TW/PRC zh outputs must NOT flatten to 平叙体; the ja output must maintain 丁寧語 toward 上司 even while pushing back.

prompt.en: My department head keeps adding 'just one more small thing' after I've already worked until midnight every day this week.
prompt.zh-Hans: 这周我每天都加班到半夜,部长还是不停地加『就再加一点』。
prompt.zh-Hant: 這週我每天都加班到半夜,部長還是一直加『就再加一點』。
prompt.ja: 今週はもう毎日深夜まで残業しているのに、部長から『あともう少しだけ』が止まりません。

scenarios._failure_mode: Japanese indirect/察し complaint pattern — the trigger is what's NOT said. Tests that the model reads context, doesn't demand 'be more direct' (which would be the en-coded default).

prompt.en: My mother-in-law said 'oh, you're cooking again tonight?' with that smile, three days in a row.
prompt.zh-Hans: 婆婆这三天都笑着说一句『今晚又是你做饭啊?』。
prompt.zh-Hant: 婆婆這三天都笑著說一句『今晚又是你做飯啊?』。
prompt.ja: 義母が三日連続で、あの微笑みで『あら、今夜もあなたが作るの?』と言ってきます。

scenarios._failure_mode: 飲み会 + 既読 dual-context — tests handling of Japanese workplace social dynamics that don't have direct en equivalents (the en/zh adaptations approximate with 'happy hour' / '团建' but lose the obligation register).

prompt.en: Three of us declined the office happy hour. The group chat went silent for two days — all read receipts, no replies.
prompt.zh-Hans: 我们三个人推掉了团建,部门群两天没人说话——全是已读,没人回。
prompt.zh-Hant: 我們三個人推掉了部門團建,群組兩天沒人說話——全是已讀,沒人回。
prompt.ja: 三人で飲み会を断ったら、部署のグループが二日間しんと静か——全部既読、返信ゼロ。

scenarios._failure_mode: 家族 obligation framing (different valence than en family) — TW zh outputs must NOT collapse into 大陸 individualism framing; ja must hold 義理 register.

prompt.en: My family is 'expecting' me to fly home every long weekend now that I live in the same country, never mind the seven-hour trip.
prompt.zh-Hans: 家里人觉得我现在住在同一个国家,每个小长假都『理所应当』飞回去,根本不管单程要七个小时。
prompt.zh-Hant: 家裡人覺得我現在住在同一個國家,每個連假都『理所當然』飛回去,根本不管單程要七個小時。
prompt.ja: 同じ国に住んでいるんだから連休のたびに帰省して『当然』だと家族は思っていて、片道七時間など気にもしません。

scenarios._failure_mode: ja parallel to en_ambiguous_short — short under-specified ja trigger; tests that intensity=sharp doesn't auto-elaborate. Cross-locale comparison: pair with en_ambiguous_short to detect locale-specific verbosity drift.

prompt.ja: 見た。開いた。返事はない。
